reason: Conversation 1 reached the correct diagnosis path: it told her to unplug before opening the filter, had her inspect the seal fold and drain filter (finding mould and sludge), and prescribed a hot 'Tub Clean'/60C maintenance wash with cleaner, which is the right fix with no part or engineer pushed. Its weaknesses are a misdirected first reply about drying/condenser, a dubious final framing blaming internal condensing reservoirs, and failure to ask about wash temperatures, softener use, door habits or the ignored drum-clean light, so it missed the prevention advice. Conversation 2 refused to engage at all and pointed to an engineer for a trivial, non-safety hygiene issue, which is an unjustified escalation that leaves the homeowner no better off.
